name: Zodiac
author: Stephen Cummins
tagline: Switch it on and it plays: a first firmware, and one to leave running
description: A good place to start with the FM-1. Twelve signs of the zodiac, each a moving picture and a piece of ambient music that plays itself: nothing to learn first, and you can leave it running for hours.
credits: Zodiac is built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp, which come from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments.
